main.description: Reads the durable receipt for a label operation.

operationId.description: The stable identifier supplied with the label operation.

reason.description: An optional explanation for inspecting the operation receipt.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated caller does not have permission to inspect operations.

errors.name: OperationNotFound
errors.description: No matching durable operation receipt exists.

errors.name: StorageUnavailable
errors.description: The operation receipt could not be read because storage is unavailable.

errors.name: ServiceUnavailable
errors.description: The labeler service is temporarily unavailable.
